note: The minister told the Assemblée nationale on 28 January 2026 that health information systems and digitised management systems are being introduced in model reference hospitals and have improved the patient pathway; the document does not say they hold the clinical record or carry routine aggregate reporting, so they are unclassified and give no fact. The digital centre is telemedicine and emergency tracking (enabling); the financial system is administration, outside the typology.
